coordinates: Panel inches: x right and y down from the panel's top-left corner. Add the panel's x and y to get page inches.

front.view: As you face the performer: their right is on your left.

back.view: As you stand behind the performer: their left is on your left.

cape.view: The cape seen from behind: their left is on your left.

wrapBand.about: The outer 15% of each half-width, measured in from each side seam, wraps round the side of the body and is squeezed there.

seams.about: Each region's seams list both side seams' x at every step of height. Edges are named for the body. A seam joins the front panel's left edge to the back panel's right edge at the same height, so a stripe drawn at height y on both panels meets itself at both sides.
